title: A $2k$-regular graph on $4k+1$ vertices is Hamiltonian
statement: Let $k \ge 1$ be an integer, and let $G$ be a finite simple graph on $4k+1$ vertices in which every vertex has degree exactly $2k$. Then $G$ has a Hamiltonian cycle, that is, a cycle passing through every vertex of $G$ exactly once.
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph
